title: Is the sign inside the base?
text: The parentheses include the minus sign in the base, so you multiply $$-3$$ by $$-3$$. A common mistake is to square only the 3 and then make the answer negative. Two negative factors have which kind of product?

title: Multiply the absolute values
text: The sign is settled. What is $$3 \times 3$$?

title: Worked solution
text: $$(-3)^{2} = (-3) \times (-3) = 9$$. Common mistake: answering $$-9$$, which is the value of $$-3^{2}$$ without parentheses. General rule: a negative base in parentheses, raised to an even power, is positive, because the minus signs pair up.
